reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: §5(a) fees, §6 minimum monthly fee language, §13 term and §14 termination contain no liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination/stipulated-sum charge payable by Client.
Termination under §14 exposes Client only to fees through the last day of the month following notice (~1-2 months), well inside the 3-month fallback, so no Customer-payable LD trigger exists.
Consistent with a compliant finding, the redline is identical to the original paragraphs and no counterparty comment is proposed; deterministic checks are empty, confirming no unintended edits.
Minimum monthly fees are correctly characterized as consideration for services rather than damages, so the direction test (Customer pays LD) is not met and no actionable edit is warranted.
